AnkiDroid with [ankiquest](https://github.com/float3/ankiquest) support: XP, combo, quest and level feedback while reviewing, and the leaderboard from the star button on the deck list.

This update supports private AnkiQuest servers. Leaderboard and profile requests use your saved member token, and the embedded website signs in automatically. Your token stays out of website links. Existing public servers remain supported.

Update the app before your server administrator enables private mode. Keep your personal member token in Settings → ankiquest; the shared website password is for browser access, not uploads or personal account controls.

Installs next to the official AnkiDroid as "AnkiDroid Quest". Log in to AnkiWeb and sync to get your cards, then fill in Settings → ankiquest (server URL, player, token). Later releases are offered inside the app.

Only review log rows (card id, timestamp, previous interval, time taken, review type) are sent to the ankiquest server, never card content.
